intro: AI stocks plummeted globally today as rising datacenter and chip costs weighed on the sector, though broader markets remained resilient. OpenAI is nearing a $30 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, positioning itself for a 2027 IPO with backing from UAE investors. Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent for professionals, while Microsoft demonstrated its diagnostic AI tool outperforming human physicians by up to four times on medical cases.

whitelist.title: Artificial Intelligence
whitelist.desc: Artificial intelligence is more a part of our lives than ever before. While some might call it hype and compare it to NFTs or 3D TVs, AI is causing a sea change in nearly every part of the technology industry. OpenAI’s ChatGPT is arguably the best-known AI chatbot around, but with Google pushing Gemini, Microsoft building Copilot, and Apple working to make Siri good, AI is probably going to be in the spotlight for a very long time.
